Implemented IDisposable to fix errors on exit
Added dedicated Compute queue. This allows compute shader dispatches to run earlier in the frame before rendering and asynchronously alongside the graphics queue if the hardware supports it.
Added ground clutter instanced renderer.
Added a macro "THREAD_SYNC_BARRIER" which maps to "barrier()" in Shared.glsl to make intent easier to discern when used in shaders.

Added a basic CommandBufferPool class. This holds command buffers but also allows for flexible submitting; you can either queue up work to be submitted in time for rendering after all buffers have been recorded or you can opt to submit it immediately which may improve performance while other operations in the frame are still completing.
Added a CommandBufferPool instance to the renderer for use on the dedicated Compute queue.

Added CommonBufferValues class. This class holds a small buffer with some commonly used uint values in DeviceLocal memory. An example use case would be using this buffer as a source for a transfer that  resets a count to 0 in another buffer.
Optimized the compute shader responsible for ground clutter culling by using groupshared memory to accumulate local workgroup object counts before adding the count to the global object count.
Implemented BVH lookup on the GPU for ground clutter terrain placement.
Added groupshared memory usage to the clutter generation shader to optimize atomic counter operations.
Made the ground clutter indirect draw command buffer DeviceLocal.

Moved the ground clutter buffer count resets off the CPU and instead the count is now reset via a buffer copy. This means the entire ground clutter system, minus initial grid cell updates, is now entirely processed on the GPU.
Cleaned up the majority of the ground clutter system code.
Updated the ground clutter system to use the updated CreateDescriptorPool and CreateDescriptorSetLayout functions.
Properly handle MappedMemory instances.
